variantsConverted.from: no tv(); direction comes from paneforge data-direction; skin only styles the grip
variantsConverted.to: typed geometry/chrome props on PaneGroup + withHandle on Handle

propsInvented.name: bordered
propsInvented.why: Every documented example wraps the group in class="… border". Without class merging the group cannot express a frame.

propsInvented.name: radius
propsInvented.why: Examples use rounded-lg on the group frame.

propsInvented.name: maxWidth / minHeight / maxHeight
propsInvented.why: Examples size the group through class (max-w-md, min-h-[200px]). Only props that survive paneforge's mergeProps (which always writes height/width: 100% last) are exposed.

propsInvented.name: withHandle
propsInvented.why: Present upstream on Handle; kept as the only visual toggle for the grip pill.

deviations.why: paneforge PaneGroupState always emits style height/width 100% and mergeProps lets that win over consumer style. Source demos use min-h / max-w classes (or h-[200px] on pane content) instead.
deviations.risk: medium — consumers expecting height= will need minHeight or a sized parent

deviations.what: Handle grip uses data-slot='resizable-handle-icon' instead of a bare div + cn-resizable-handle-icon class
deviations.why: data-slot is the library styling hook; no cn() / skin class namespace

deviations.what: Focus ring is box-shadow 1px offset + 1px ring instead of Tailwind --tw-ring-* plumbing
deviations.why: oracle rule: never copy --tw-*; ring-1 + ring-offset-1 + ring-ring resolves to background offset then ring colour
deviations.risk: low — matches intent; offset colour uses --background

deviations.what: Pane is re-exported raw from paneforge (no wrapper)
deviations.why: Matches source index.ts; no data-slot or skin on Pane
